Package com.bilt.pos.session.basket

Class BasketItem

java.lang.Object
com.bilt.pos.session.basket.BasketItem
public final class BasketItem extends Object
An item added to the basket by the register.

Factories state the commercial intent directly: sale(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, int, java.lang.String), returnItem(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, int, java.lang.String), credit(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, int, java.lang.String), or storedValueLoad(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String). Ordinary merchandise is upserted by SKU and direction. Stored value load lines are distinct obligations keyed by their register reference, so buying two cards with the same SKU produces two lines instead of quantity two.

A stored value load line contains only receipt-safe commercial data. The card and activation/reload instruction belong in the settlement options and are joined to this line by getReference().
